title: The Night Manager (British TV series)
production_companies: Amazon MGM StudiosCredited as producing in the international broadcast. Also hold international distribution rights along with Fifth Season
premise_summary: The Night Manager is a British spy thriller television serial based on the 1993 novel by John le Carré and adapted by David Farr. The six-part first series, directed by Susanne Bier and starring Tom Hiddleston, Hugh Laurie, Olivia Colman, Tom Hollander, David Harewood and Elizabeth Debicki, began broadcasting on BBC One on 21 February 2016.
